title: Dog
description: Schema for dog data collected from ShelterLuv. Frontend renders: Name, Age, Size, Gender, Status, Photos, Description, CaseManager, AdoptionCategory, MedicalCategory, BehaviorCategory. Supports role-based access to foster contact information and structured memo tabs.

Internal-ID.description: [API] ShelterLuv internal unique identifier - from ShelterLuv API field 'Internal-ID'

ID.description: [API] ShelterLuv public animal ID - from ShelterLuv API field 'ID'

Name.description: [API] Dog's name - from ShelterLuv API field 'Name'

Breed.description: [API] Dog's breed - from ShelterLuv API field 'Breed'

AgeYears.description: [DERIVED] Canonical age in years for sorting/filtering (e.g., 3.5 for 3 years 6 months) - computed from ShelterLuv age data

AgeDisplay.description: [DERIVED] Human-readable age representation (e.g., '3 years', 'Adult', 'Senior') - computed from ShelterLuv age data

Size.description: [API] Dog's size category - from ShelterLuv API field 'Size'. UNKNOWN indicates size could not be determined.

Gender.description: [API] Dog's gender - from ShelterLuv API field 'Gender'

Status.description: [API] Current status in shelter system - from ShelterLuv API field 'Status'. UNKNOWN indicates status could not be determined from ShelterLuv data.

Description.description: [API] Dog's description/bio - from ShelterLuv API field 'Description'

items.description: [API] URL to dog photo - from ShelterLuv API field 'Photos'

Photos.description: [API] Array of photo URLs - from ShelterLuv API field 'Photos'

CaseManager.description: [SCRAPED] Assigned case manager name - scraped from ShelterLuv profile section

MemosRawHTML.description: [SCRAPED] Raw HTML content of all memos/notes - scraped from ShelterLuv memos page

PersonalityNotes.description: [DERIVED] Personality and behavior notes extracted from MemosRawHTML - categorized by ETL based on keywords (personality, behavior, temperament, etc.)

IntakeNotes.description: [DERIVED] Intake and background notes extracted from MemosRawHTML - categorized by ETL based on keywords (intake, background, history, etc.)

MedicalNotes.description: [DERIVED] Medical notes extracted from MemosRawHTML - categorized by ETL based on keywords (medical, health, vet, treatment, etc.)

AdoptionCategory.description: [SCRAPED] Adoption category - scraped from ShelterLuv profile section

MedicalCategory.description: [SCRAPED] Medical category - scraped from ShelterLuv profile section

BehaviorCategory.description: [SCRAPED] Behavior category - scraped from ShelterLuv profile section

FullAnimalProfile.description: [SCRAPED] Full animal profile text - scraped from ShelterLuv profile section

Treatments.description: [DERIVED] Medical treatments history - structured from scraped data

IntakeDate.description: [API] Date the dog was taken into custody - from ShelterLuv API field 'IntakeDate'

Location.description: [API] Current location in shelter - from ShelterLuv API field 'Location'

Stage.description: [API] Current stage in adoption process - from ShelterLuv API field 'Stage'

Weight.description: [API] Dog's weight in pounds - from ShelterLuv API field 'Weight'

FosterName.description: [DERIVED] Name of current foster parent - derived from ShelterLuv events and people data. ROLE RESTRICTED: closers/staff only

FosterPhone.description: [DERIVED] Foster parent's phone number - derived from ShelterLuv people data. ROLE RESTRICTED: closers/staff only

FosterEmail.description: [DERIVED] Foster parent's email address - derived from ShelterLuv people data. ROLE RESTRICTED: closers/staff only

ScrapeError.description: [DERIVED] Error message if scraping dog details failed - shows in UI as warning

IsInCustody.description: [DERIVED] Dog is currently in Muttville's custody - derived from ETL source (ShelterLuv 'In Custody' view). All animals in Firestore for this ETL run are currently in custody unless ETL is changed.

IsAvailableForAdoption.description: [DERIVED] Dog is currently available for adoption - computed from Status by ETL

IsHospice.description: [DERIVED] Dog is in hospice care program - computed from MedicalCategory, Stage, and events by ETL

IsEventDog.description: [DERIVED] Dog participates in public events - computed from event history by ETL
